assets.title: OpenShift — deployment workshop
assets.scene: A cutaway application deployment workshop: three connected red-framed modular server bays with removable compute trays, one central application assembly workbench and a small routing gantry connecting them. Three clear physical work zones connected by an inset cyan floor track, from assembly through deployment to an outward-facing service gateway. Show an elegant practical cluster environment with visible cables, doors and a few grounded red modules; no shipping containers. The broad central gateway is the focal point.

assets.title: Ansible — automation control room
assets.scene: A cutaway automation control room with one central indigo orchestration console and a precise fan of three red-and-white industrial workstations connected by tidy cyan cable paths. Mechanical relay cabinets and repeatable matching actuator modules show coordinated work, with one small red physical switch bank as focal point. The architecture feels like a beautifully organized modern workshop where one central instruction coordinates many devices; no charts, text or floating UI.
